description: Returns workout metadata, preview assets, and summary. Use when the user selects a workout or asks for details about a specific workout. sample-* ids return a curated sample detail (no auth). Connected team workout ids use the Internal API (same data as get_team_workout). Other org ids use the Content API when the team has API entitlement. Not for the playable segment list (use get_workout_playlist).

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

workout_id.description: Workout ID: a sample-* ID from list_sample_workouts, or a team workout ID from list_team_workouts.

name: get_workout_details
title: Get workout details
